d: Anticamera with cymbal. Lamberto contrasting with Lauretta.
Lauretta, and Lamberto, then Giacomina; then Leandro.
Lamberto, Colagianni, Mariuccio, and then Lauretta.
Lamberto, Elisa, Bettina, Colagianni, and Mariuccio.
Lamberto, and the Copier, then Colagianni, and Lauretta.
Elisa, Mariuccio, then Leandro, who observes.
Lauretta, with some Comparse, who bring chairs, and then Lamberto with a bag, and a mask.
Lamberto, and the Copier, who gives him the parts of the serenade.
Giacomina, Elisa, Lauretta, Bettina, Mariuccio, and Colagianni reverence Lamberto, and everyone sits at his place taking his part of the serenade, which is given to him by Lamberto.
Lauretta, and Mariuccio with mask in his hands.
Colagianni ridiculely disguised, and Lamberto masked woman, carried by the hands of Colagianni, one not knowing the other.
All masked by singing come out by hand.
